episode.title: Beware of the Crisis

chapters.title: Intro: Is a Crisis a Good Thing?

episode.tagline: There are people who argue that real reforms can only happen in a crisis. A crisis is a terrible thing to waste, they say.
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay explains how crises, most of the time, lead to terrible outcomes. Chaos is a ladder. And to actually do reforms during a crisis, you need not just the circumstance but also a scaffolding of factors in policy and politics and culture that need to be in place already.
